question_summary: Confirm whether the minimum cover for underground utility trench backfill shown on Civil Detail 2/C501 and specified in Section 31 23 00 complies with the Geotechnical Report requirements for this area, ahead of civil inspection.
deadline_text: Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.
assigned_reviewer: Civil Engineer of Record (with Geotechnical EOR concurrence)
routing_rationale: The query concerns trench backfill cover shown on a civil detail and Division 31 spec, requiring confirmation against geotechnical recommendations, which the Civil EOR should lead with input from the Geotechnical EOR.
